title: St Stephen's Parish, Copley, Halifax - WW1 and WW2
memorial_details: description: TO THE GLORY OF GOD/ AND AS A TRIBUTE TO THE MEN/ OF THIS PARISH/ WHOSE NAMES ARE HERE RECORDED/ WHO GAVE THEIR LIVES FOR/ KING AND COUNTRY/ IN THE GREAT WAR 1914-1919,/ THIS MEMORIAL HAS BEEN/ ERECTED BY THE PARISHIONERS/ OF COPLEY AND IN/ GRATEFUL REMEMBRANCE/ OF THOSE WHO/ SERVED/ (24 Names)/ 1939-1945/ (5 Names)
